# Step[¶](#step "Permalink to this heading")

The Step commands described in this chapter are used to create and configure analysis steps. Step commands (output) describes the commands used to create and configure output requests and integrated output sections and the commands to configure diagnostic printing, monitoring, and restart. Step commands (miscellaneous) describes the commands used to configure controls, damping, and frequency tables.

Objects in Step

* [Step Miscellaneous](step_miscellaneous.html)

    This object can be accessed by:

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].BuckleStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [BuckleStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-bucklesteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            numEigen[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.numEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of eigenvalues to be estimated.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            eigensolver=`abaqusConstants.SUBSPACE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.eigensolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the eigensolver. Possible values are SUBSPACE and LANCZOS.
                The default value is SUBSPACE.

            minEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.minEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the minimum eigenvalue of interest. The default value is
                None.

            maxEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.maxEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum eigenvalue of interest. The default value is
                None.

            vectors=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.vectors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of vectors used in the iteration. The default value is the
                minimum of (2\*n\*, **n** + 8), where **n** is the number of eigenvalues requested.

            maxIterations=`30`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.maxIterations "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of iterations. The default value is 30.

            blockSize=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.blockSize "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or an Int specifying the size of the Lanczos block steps.
                The default value is DEFAULT.

            maxBlocks=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.maxBlocks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or an Int specifying the maximum number of Lanczos block
                steps within each Lanczos run. The default value is DEFAULT. Note: *minEigen*,
                **blockSize**, and **maxBlocks** are ignored unless **eigensolver** = LANCZOS.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.BuckleStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

        :   **step** – A BuckleStep object.

        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step

            numEigen=`abaqusConstants.ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.numEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant ALL or an Int specifying the number of complex eigenmodes to be
                calculated or a SymbolicConstant ALL. The default value is ALL.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            :   A Boolean specifying whether to add to the damping matrix contributions due to friction
                effects. The default value is OFF.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            minEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.minEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the minimum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            maxEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.maxEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            propertyEvaluationFrequency=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ComplexFrequencyStep.propertyEvaluationFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the frequency at which to evaluate frequency-dependent
                properties for viscoelasticity, springs, and dashpots during the eigenvalue extraction.
                If the value is None, the analysis product will evaluate the stiffness associated with
                frequency-dependent springs and dashpots at zero frequency and will not consider the
                stiffness contributions from frequency-domain viscoelasticity in the step. The default
                value is None.

    :   This method creates a CoupledTempDisplacementStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].CoupledTempDisplacementStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [CoupledTempDisplacementStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-coupledtempdisplacementsteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            response=`abaqusConstants.TRANSIENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.response "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the analysis type. Possible values are STEADY\_STATE and
                TRANSIENT. The default value is TRANSIENT.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period for the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable and **stabilizationMethod** ≠ NONE. The default value is
                2x10⁻⁴.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            deltmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.deltmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum temperature change to be allowed in an increment in a
                transient analysis. The default value is 0.0.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum difference in the creep strain increment calculated from
                the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The default value is
                0.0.

            creepIntegration=`abaqusConstants.IMPLICIT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.creepIntegration "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of integration to be used for creep and swelling
                effects throughout the step. Possible values are IMPLICIT, EXPLICIT, and NONE. The
                default value is IMPLICIT.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solution technique. Possible values are
                FULL\_NEWTON and SEPARATED. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. The default value is STEP. Possible values are STEP and RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

"Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a DirectCyclicStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].DirectCyclicStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [DirectCyclicStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-directcyclicsteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the time of single loading cycle. The default value is 1.0.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            maxNumIterations=`200`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxNumIterations "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of iterations in a step. The default value is 200.

            initialTerms=`11`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.initialTerms "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the initial number of terms in the Fourier series. The default value
                is 11.

            maxTerms=`25`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxTerms "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of terms in the Fourier series. The default value
                is 25.

            termsIncrement=`5`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.termsIncrement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the increment in number of terms in the Fourier series. The default
                value is 5.

            deltmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.deltmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum temperature change to be allowed in an increment. The
                default value is 0.0.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum difference in the creep strain increment calculated from
                the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The default value is
                0.0.

            timePoints=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.timePoints "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a String specifying a String specifying the name of a time point object used to
                determine at which times the response of the structure will be evaluated. The default
                value is NONE.

            fatigue=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.fatigue "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include low-cycle fatigue analysis. The default value is
                OFF.

            continueAnalysis=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.continueAnalysis "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the displacement solution in the Fourier series obtained in
                the previous direct cyclic step is used as the starting values for the current step. The
                default value is OFF.

            minCycleInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.minCycleInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the minimum number of cycles over which the damage is extrapolated
                forward. The default value is 100.

            maxCycleInc=`1000`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxCycleInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of cycles over which the damage is extrapolated
                forward. The default value is 1000.

            maxNumCycles=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maxNumCycles "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or an Int specifying the maximum number of cycles allowed
                in a step or DEFAULT. A value of 1 plus half of the maximum number of cycles will be
                used if DEFAULT is specified. The default value is DEFAULT.

            damageExtrapolationTolerance=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.damageExtrapolationTolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum extrapolated damage increment. The default value is 1.0.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A DirectCyclicStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`DirectCyclicStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.DirectCyclicStep (Python class) — Bases: AnalysisStep")

                value is AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL.

            maxIncrement=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.maxIncrement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum time increment. If there is no upper limit,
                **maxIncrement** = None. This argument is required only when
                **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL or AUTOMATIC\_EBE. The default value is None.

            scaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.scaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor that is used to scale the time increment. This argument is
                required only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, or
                FIXED\_EBE. The default value is 1.0.

            massScaling=`abaqusConstants.PREVIOUS_STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.massScaling "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A MassScalingArray object specifying
                mass scaling controls. The default value is PREVIOUS\_STEP.

            linearBulkViscosity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.linearBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the linear bulk viscosity parameter, b1b1. The default value is 0.06.

            quadBulkViscosity=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.quadBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the quadratic bulk viscosity parameter, b2b2. The default value is
                1.2.

            userDefinedInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.userDefinedInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the user-defined time increment. This argument is required
                only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = FIXED\_USER\_DEFINED\_INC. The default value is None.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            improvedDtMethod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.improvedDtMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to use the “improved” (**improvedDtMethod** = ON) or
                “conservative” (**improvedDtMethod** = OFF) method to estimate the element stable time
                increment for three-dimensional continuum elements and elements with plane stress
                formulations (shell, membrane, and two-dimensional plane stress elements). The default
                value is ON.

                New in version 2018: The **improvedDtMethod** argument was added.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – An ExplicitDynamicsStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`ExplicitDynamicsStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep (Python class) — Bases: AnalysisStep")

    :   This method creates a FrequencyStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].FrequencyStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [FrequencyStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-frequencysteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            eigensolver[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.eigensolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the eigensolver. Possible values are LANCZOS, SUBSPACE,
                and AMS.The following optional arguments are ignored unless **eigensolver** = LANCZOS:
                **blockSize**, **maxBlocks**, **normalization**, **propertyEvaluationFrequency**.The following
                optional arguments are ignored unless **eigensolver** = LANCZOS or AMS: **minEigen**,
                **maxEigen**, and **acousticCoupling**.The following optional arguments are ignored unless
                **eigensolver** = AMS: **projectDamping**, **acousticRangeFactor**,
                **substructureCutoffMultiplier**, **firstCutoffMultiplier**, **secondCutoffMultiplier**,
                **residualModeRegion**, **regionalModeDof**, and **limitSavedEigenvectorRegion**.

            numEigen=`abaqusConstants.ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.numEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant ALL or an Int specifying the number of eigenvalues to be calculated
                or ALL. The default value is ALL.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            shift=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.shift "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the shift point in cycles per time. The default value is 0.0.

            minEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.minEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the minimum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            maxEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.maxEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            vectors=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.vectors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or an Int specifying the number of vectors used in the iteration. The default is
                the minimum of (2\*n\*, **n** + 8), where **n** is the number of eigenvalues requested. The
                default value is None.

            maxIterations=`30`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.maxIterations "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of iterations. The default value is 30.

            blockSize=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.blockSize "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the size of the Lanczos block steps. The default value is
                DEFAULT.

            maxBlocks=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.maxBlocks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the maximum number of Lanczos block steps within each
                Lanczos run. The default value is DEFAULT.

            normalization=`abaqusConstants.DISPLACEMENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.normalization "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method for normalizing eigenvectors. Possible values
                are DISPLACEMENT and MASS. The default value is DISPLACEMENT.A value of DISPLACEMENT
                indicates normalizing the eigenvectors so that the largest displacement entry in each
                vector is unity. A value of MASS indicates normalizing the eigenvectors with respect to
                the structure’s mass matrix, which results in scaling the eigenvectors so that the
                generalized mass for each vector is unity.

            propertyEvaluationFrequency=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.propertyEvaluationFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the frequency at which to evaluate frequency-dependent
                properties for viscoelasticity, springs, and dashpots during the eigenvalue extraction.
                If the value is None, the analysis product will evaluate the stiffness associated with
                frequency-dependent springs and dashpots at zero frequency and will not consider the
                stiffness contributions from frequency-domain viscoelasticity in the step. The default
                value is None.

            projectDamping=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.projectDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include projection of viscous and structural damping
                operators during **AMS** eigenvalue extraction. Valid only when **eigenSolver** = AMS. The
                default value is ON.

            acousticCoupling=`abaqusConstants.AC_ON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.acousticCoupling "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of acoustic-structural coupling in models with
                acoustic and structural elements coupled using the TIE option or in models with ASI-type
                elements. Possible values are AC\_ON, AC\_OFF, and AC\_PROJECTION. The default value is
                AC\_ON.

            acousticRangeFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.acousticRangeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the maximum acoustic frequency to the maximum structural
                frequency. The default value is 1.0.

            frictionDamping=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.frictionDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to add to the damping matrix contributions due to friction
                effects. The default value is OFF.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            simLinearDynamics=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.simLinearDynamics "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to activate the SIM-based linear dynamics procedures. The
                default value is OFF.

            residualModes=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include residual modes from an immediately preceding
                Static, Linear Perturbation step. The default value is OFF.

            substructureCutoffMultiplier=`5`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.substructureCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the cutoff frequency for substructure eigenproblems, defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 5.0.

            firstCutoffMultiplier=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.firstCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the first cutoff frequency for a reduced eigenproblem, defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 1.7.

            secondCutoffMultiplier=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.secondCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the second cutoff frequency for a reduced eigenproblem defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 1.1.

            residualModeRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModeRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Strings specifying the name of a region for which residual modes
                are requested. The default value is None.

            residualModeDof=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModeDof "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Ints specifying the degree of freedom for which residual modes are
                requested. The default value is None.

            limitSavedEigenvectorRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep.limitSavedEigenvectorRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Region object specifying a region for which eigenvectors should be saved or
                the SymbolicConstant None representing the whole model. The default value is None.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A FrequencyStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.FrequencyStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`FrequencyStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep (Python class) — Bases: AnalysisStep")

Possible values are FULL_NEWTON and QUASI_NEWTON.")=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`*, *[reformKernel](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.reformKernel "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.reformKernel (Python parameter) — An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix is reformed..")=`8`*, SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used.")=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`*, *[maxNumInc](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.maxNumInc *[initialInc](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.initialInc "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.initialInc (Python parameter) — A Float specifying the initial time increment.")=`None`*, *[minInc](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.minInc "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.minInc (Python parameter) — A Float specifying the minimum time time increment allowed.")=`None`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L1206-L1316)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a GeostaticStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].GeostaticStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [GeostaticStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-geostaticsteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            utol=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.utol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the tolerance for maximum change of displacements. The
                default value is None.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0. Note: This parameter
                is ignored unless **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

                New in version 2017: The `maxNumInc` attribute was added to the GeostaticStep class.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step. Note: This parameter is ignored unless
                **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period. Note: This
                parameter is ignored unless **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.GeostaticStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step. Note: This parameter is ignored unless
                **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC.

    :   This method creates a HeatTransferStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].HeatTransferStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [HeatTransferStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-heattransfersteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            response=`abaqusConstants.TRANSIENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.response "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the analysis type. Possible values are STEADY\_STATE and
                TRANSIENT. The default value is TRANSIENT.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of 0.8 times the initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            end=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.end "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the temperature change rate (temperature per time) used to
                define steady state. When all nodal temperatures are changing at less than this rate,
                the solution terminates. The default value is None. Note: This parameter is ignored unless
                **response** = STEADY\_STATE.

            deltmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.deltmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum temperature change to be allowed in an increment during a
                transient heat transfer analysis. The default value is 0.0.

            mxdem=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.mxdem "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable emissivity change with temperature and field
                variables during an increment. The default value is 0.1.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. The default is STEP. Possible values are STEP and RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A HeatTransferStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.HeatTransferStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`HeatTransferStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.HeatTransferStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.HeatTransferStep (Python class) — Bases: AnalysisStep")

    :   This method creates an ImplicitDynamicsStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ImplicitDynamicsStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [ImplicitDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-implicitdynamicssteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period of the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is based on the previous step.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            application=`abaqusConstants.ANALYSIS_PRODUCT_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.application "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the application type of the step. Possible values are
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT, TRANSIENT\_FIDELITY, MODERATE\_DISSIPATION, and QUASI\_STATIC.
                The default value is ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether an adiabatic stress analysis is to be performed. The
                default value is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed.

            hafTolMethod=`abaqusConstants.VALUE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.hafTolMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the way of specifying half-increment residual tolerance
                with the automatic time incrementation scheme. Possible values are
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT, VALUE, and SCALE. The default value is VALUE.

            haftol=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.haftol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the half-increment residual tolerance to be used with the
                automatic time incrementation scheme. The default value is None.

            halfIncScaleFactor=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.halfIncScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the half-increment residual tolerance scale factor to be used
                with the automatic time incrementation scheme. The default value is None.

            nohaf=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.nohaf "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to suppress calculation of the half-increment residual. The
                default value is OFF.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is STEP.

            alpha=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the nondefault value of the numerical
                (artificial) damping control parameter, αα, in the implicit operator. Possible values
                are −.333 <α< 0. The default value is DEFAULT.

            initialConditions=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.initialConditions "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether accelerations should be calculated or recalculated
                at the beginning of the step. Possible values are DEFAULT, BYPASS, and ALLOW. The
                default value is DEFAULT.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.ANALYSIS_PRODUCT_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR,
                PARABOLIC, VELOCITY\_PARABOLIC, and ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT. The default value is
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed have been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = OFF only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.


        Note

        Check [ResponseSpectrumStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-responsespectrumsteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            components[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.components "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A ResponseSpectrumComponentArray object.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            comp=`abaqusConstants.SINGLE_DIRECTION`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.comp "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the order and method used to sum the components. Possible
                values are SINGLE\_DIRECTION, MULTIPLE\_DIRECTION\_ABSOLUTE\_SUM,
                MULTIPLE\_DIRECTION\_SRSS\_SUM, MULTIPLE\_DIRECTION\_THIRTY\_PERCENT\_RULE, and
                MULTIPLE\_DIRECTION\_FORTY\_PERCENT\_RULE. The default value is SINGLE\_DIRECTION.

            sum=`abaqusConstants.ABS`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.sum "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method used to sum the components. Possible values are
                ABS, CQC, NRL, SRSS, TENP, DSC, and GRP. The default value is ABS.

            directDamping=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.directDamping "Permalink to this definition")

            compositeDamping=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.compositeDamping "Permalink to this definition")

            rayleighDamping=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.rayleighDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RayleighDamping object.

            directDampingByFrequency=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.directDampingByFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A DirectDampingByFrequency object.

            rayleighDampingByFrequency=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.rayleighDampingByFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A RayleighDampingByFrequency object.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ResponseSpectrumStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

    :   This method creates a SoilsStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].SoilsStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [SoilsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-soilssteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            response=`abaqusConstants.TRANSIENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.response "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the analysis type. Possible values are STEADY\_STATE and
                TRANSIENT. The default value is TRANSIENT.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            creep=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.creep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether a creep response occurs during this step. The default value
                is ON.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            end=`abaqusConstants.PERIOD`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.end "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time period to be analyzed in a transient analysis.
                Possible values are PERIOD and SS. The default value is PERIOD.

            utol=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.utol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum pore pressure change permitted in any increment
                (in pressure units) in a transient consolidation analysis. The default value is None.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable difference in the creep strain increment
                calculated from the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The
                default value is 0.0.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. The default value is STEP. Possible values are STEP and RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A SoilsStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SoilsStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`SoilsStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep (Python class) — Bases: AnalysisStep")

    :   This method creates a StaticLinearPerturbationStep object.


        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same

                New in version 2024: The argument `scaleFactor` was added.
