    :   This method creates a StaticRiksStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].StaticRiksStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [StaticRiksStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-staticrikssteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to perform an adiabatic stress analysis. The default value
                is OFF.

            maxLPF=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.maxLPF "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum value of the load proportionality factor. The
                default value is None.

            nodeOn=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.nodeOn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to monitor the finishing displacement value at a node. The
                default value is OFF.

            maximumDisplacement=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.maximumDisplacement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the total displacement (or rotation) at the node and
                degree of freedom that, if crossed during an increment, ends the step at the current
                increment. This argument is required when **nodeOn** = ON. The default value is 0.0.

            dof=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.dof "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the degree of freedom being monitored. This argument is required when
                **nodeOn** = ON. The default value is 0.

            region=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.region "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the vertex at which the finishing displacement value is being
                monitored. This argument is required when **nodeOn** = ON.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            totalArcLength=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.totalArcLength "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total load proportionality factor associated with the load in
                this step. The default value is 1.0.

            initialArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.initialArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial load proportionality factor. The default value is the
                total load proportionality factor for the step.

            minArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.minArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum arc length increment allowed. The default value is the
                smaller of the suggested initial load proportionality factor or 10−5 times the total
                load proportionality factor for the step.

            maxArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.maxArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum arc length increment allowed. The default value is the
                total load proportionality factor for the step.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            fullyPlastic=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.fullyPlastic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the region being monitored for fully Plastic behavior.
                The default value is an empty string.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed have been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = ON only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            useLongTermSolution=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.useLongTermSolution "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying wether to obtain the fully relaxed long-term elastic solution with
                time-domain viscoelasticity or the long-term elastic-Plastic solution for two-layer
                viscoplasticity. The default value is OFF.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

        :   **step** – A StaticRiksStep object.

    :   This method creates a StaticStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].StaticStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [StaticStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-staticsteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to perform an adiabatic stress analysis. The default value
                is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10⁻⁵ times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.RAMP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            fullyPlastic=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.fullyPlastic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the region being monitored for fully Plastic behavior. The default
                value is an empty string.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed has been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = ON only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            useLongTermSolution=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.useLongTermSolution "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying wether to obtain the fully relaxed long-term elastic solution with
                time-domain viscoelasticity or the long-term elastic-Plastic solution for two-layer
                viscoplasticity. The default value is OFF.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.StaticStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A StaticRiksStep object.

    :   This method creates a SubstructureGenerateStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].SubstructureGenerateStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [SubstructureGenerateStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-substructuregeneratesteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            substructureIdentifier[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.substructureIdentifier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Integer specifying a unique identifier for the substructure.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            recoveryMatrix=`abaqusConstants.WHOLE_MODEL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.recoveryMatrix "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the subtructure recovery to be computed. Possible values
                are WHOLE\_MODEL, REGION, and NONE. The default value is WHOLE\_MODEL.

            recoveryRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.recoveryRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the region for substructure recovery. This argument is
                required when **recoveryMatrix** = REGION.

            computeGravityLoadVectors=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.computeGravityLoadVectors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to compute the gravity load vectors. The default value is
                False.

            computeReducedMassMatrix=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.computeReducedMassMatrix "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to compute the reduced mass matrix. The default value is
                False.

            computeReducedStructuralDampingMatrix=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.computeReducedStructuralDampingMatrix "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to compute the reduced structural damping matrix. The
                default value is False.

            computeReducedViscousDampingMatrix=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.computeReducedViscousDampingMatrix "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to compute the reduced viscous damping matrix. The default
                value is False.

            evaluateFrequencyDependentProperties=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.evaluateFrequencyDependentProperties "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to evaluate the frequency dependent properties. The default
                value is False.

            frequency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the frequency at which to evaluate the frequency dependent
                properties. The default value is 0.0.

            retainedEigenmodesMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.retainedEigenmodesMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the eigenmodes to be retained. Possible values are
                MODE\_RANGE, FREQUENCY\_RANGE, and NONE. The default value is NONE.

            modeRange=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.modeRange "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SubstructureGenerateModesArray object.

            frequencyRange=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.frequencyRange "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SubstructureGenerateFrequencyArray object.

            globalDampingField=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.globalDampingField "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the field to which the global damping factors should be
                applied. Possible values are ALL, ACOUSTIC, MECHANICAL, and NONE. The default value is
                NONE.

            alphaDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.alphaDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor to create global Rayleigh mass proportional damping. The
                default value is 0.0.

            betaDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.betaDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor to create global Rayleigh stiffness proportional damping.
                The default value is 0.0.

            structuralDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.structuralDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor to create frequency-independent stiffness proportional
                structural damping. The default value is 0.0.

            viscousDampingControl=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.viscousDampingControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damping control to include the viscous damping matrix.
                Possible values are ELEMENT, FACTOR, COMBINED, and NONE. The default value is NONE.

            structuralDampingControl=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.SubstructureGenerateStep.structuralDampingControl "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damping control to include the structural damping
                matrix. Possible values are ELEMENT, FACTOR, COMBINED, and NONE. The default value is
                NONE.


        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the time period of the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC_GLOBAL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, FIXED\_USER\_DEFINED\_INC, and FIXED\_EBE. The default
                value is AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL.

            maxIncrement=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.maxIncrement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. If there is no upper
                limit, **maxIncrement** = None. The default value is None.

            scaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.scaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor that is used to scale the time increment. This argument is
                required only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, or
                FIXED\_EBE. The default value is 1.0.

            userDefinedInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.userDefinedInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the user-defined time increment. The default value is None.

            massScaling=`abaqusConstants.PREVIOUS_STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.massScaling "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A MassScalingArray object specifying mass scaling controls. The default value is
                PREVIOUS\_STEP.

            linearBulkViscosity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.linearBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the linear bulk viscosity parameter, b1b1. The default value is 0.06.

            quadBulkViscosity=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.quadBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the quadratic bulk viscosity parameter, b2b2. The default value is
                1.2.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            improvedDtMethod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.improvedDtMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to use the “improved” (**improvedDtMethod** = ON) or
                “conservative” (**improvedDtMethod** = OFF) method to estimate the element stable time
                increment for three-dimensional continuum elements and elements with plane stress
                formulations (shell, membrane, and two-dimensional plane stress elements). The default
                value is ON.

                New in version 2018: The **improvedDtMethod** argument was added.

Possible values are FULL_NEWTON and QUASI_NEWTON.")=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`*, *[reformKernel](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.reformKernel "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.reformKernel (Python parameter) — An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix is reformed..")=`8`*, *[convertSDI](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.convertSDI "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.convertSDI (Python parameter) — A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities occur during an iteration.")=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`*, *[adaptiveDampingRatio](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.adaptiveDampingRatio (Python parameter) — A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total strain energy and can be used only if stabilizationMethod is not NONE.")=`0`*, *[continueDampingFactors](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.continueDampingFactors "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.continueDampingFactors (Python parameter) — A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the results of the preceding general step.")=`0`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L3019-L3163)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep "Permalink to this definition")
    :   This method creates a ViscoStep object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].ViscoStep
        ```

        Note

        Check [ViscoStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-viscosteppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the repository key.

            previous[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.previous "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the previous step. The new step appears after this step
                in the list of analysis steps.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default is the total time
                period for the step. The default value is 1.0.

            integration=`abaqusConstants.IMPLICIT_EXPLICIT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.integration "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying which type of integration to use throughout the step.
                Possible values are IMPLICIT\_EXPLICIT and EXPLICIT\_ONLY. The default value is
                IMPLICIT\_EXPLICIT.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum difference in the creep strain increment calculated from
                the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The default value is
                0.0.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is STEP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            maintainAttributes=`False`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.maintainAttributes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to retain attributes from an existing step with the same
                name. The default value is False.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **step** – A ViscoStep object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   [`ViscoStep`](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.StepModel.ViscoStep (Python method) — This method creates a ViscoStep object.")

    The Step object stores the parameters that determine the context of the step. The Step object is the
    abstract base type for other Step objects. The Step object has no explicit constructor. The methods and
    members of the Step object are common to all objects derived from the Step.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [Step on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* AnnealStep(*[name](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep.__init__.name (Python parameter)")*, *[previous](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep.__init__.previous (Python parameter)")*, *[description](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep.__init__.description (Python parameter)")=`''`*, *[refTemp](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep.__init__.refTemp (Python parameter)")=`None`*, *[maintainAttributes](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep.__init__.maintainAttributes (Python parameter)")=`False`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L22-L197)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.AnnealStep "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The AnnealStep object anneals a structure by setting the velocities and all appropriate state variables
    to zero. The AnnealStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * ANNEAL
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [AnnealStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The BuckleStep object controls eigenvalue buckling estimation. The BuckleStep object is derived from the
    AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * BUCKLE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [BuckleStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ComplexFrequencyStep object is used to perform eigenvalue extraction to calculate the complex
    eigenvalues and corresponding complex mode shapes of a system. The ComplexFrequencyStep object is derived
    from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COMPLEX FREQUENCY
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [ComplexFrequencyStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The CoupledTempDisplacementStep object is used to analyze problems where the simultaneous solution of the
    temperature and stress/displacement fields is necessary. The CoupledTempDisplacementStep object is derived
    from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COUPLED TEMPERATURE-DISPLACEMENT
      :   + SOLUTION TECHNIQUE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [CoupledTempDisplacementStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    Member Details:

    adaptiveDampingRatio : --is-rst--float = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L135-L138)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
        strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
        value is 0.05.

    adaptiveMeshConstraintStates : --is-rst--dict[str, AdaptiveMeshConstraintState] = `{}`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L210-L211)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.adaptiveMeshConstraintStates "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A repository of AdaptiveMeshConstraintState objects.

    adaptiveMeshDomains : --is-rst--dict[str, AdaptiveMeshDomain] = `{}`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L213-L214)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.adaptiveMeshDomains "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A repository of AdaptiveMeshDomain objects.

    amplitude : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'STEP'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L121-L123)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledTempDisplacementStep.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The CoupledThermalElectricStep object is used to analyze problems where the electrical potential and
    temperature fields must be solved simultaneously. The CoupledThermalElectricStep object is derived from the
    AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COUPLED THERMAL-ELECTRICAL
      :   + SOLUTION TECHNIQUE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [CoupledThermalElectricStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep object is used to analyze problems where the simultaneous
    solution of the temperature, stress/displacement and electrical fields is necessary. The
    CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COUPLED TEMPERATURE-DISPLACEMENT
      :   + SOLUTION TECHNIQUE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   This method modifies the CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep object.

        Note

        Check [CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            response=`abaqusConstants.TRANSIENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.response "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the analysis type. Possible values are STEADY\_STATE and
                TRANSIENT. The default value is TRANSIENT.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period for the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable and **stabilizationMethod** ≠ NONE. The default value is
                2x10⁻⁴.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            deltmx=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.deltmx "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum temperature change to be allowed in an increment in a
                transient analysis. The default value is 0.0.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum difference in the creep strain increment calculated from
                the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The default value is
                0.0.

            creepIntegration=`abaqusConstants.IMPLICIT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.creepIntegration "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of integration to be used for creep and swelling
                effects throughout the step. Possible values are IMPLICIT, EXPLICIT, and NONE. The
                default value is IMPLICIT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. The default value is STEP. Possible values are STEP and RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.CoupledThermalElectricalStructuralStep.setValues.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The DirectCyclicStep object is used to provide a direct cyclic procedure for nonlinear, non-isothermal
    quasi-static analysis. It can also be used to predict progressive damage and failure for ductile bulk
    materials and/or to predict delamination/debonding growth at the interfaces in laminated composites in a
    low-cycle fatigue analysis. The DirectCyclicStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DIRECT CYCLIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [DirectCyclicStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* EmagTimeHarmonicStep(*[name](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep.__init__.name (Python parameter)")*, *[previous](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep.__init__.previous (Python parameter)")*, *[frequencyRange](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep.__init__.frequencyRange (Python parameter)")*, *[description](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep.__init__.description (Python parameter)")=`''`*, *[factorization](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep.__init__.factorization (Python parameter)")=`abaqusConstants.COMPLEX`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L34-L222)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.EmagTimeHarmonicStep "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The EmagTimeHarmonicStep object is used to calculate the electromagnetic response of the system to
    harmonic excitation of the model. The EmagTimeHarmonicStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:


:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ExplicitDynamicsStep object is used to perform a dynamic stress/displacement analysis using explicit
    integration in Abaqus/Explicit. The ExplicitDynamicsStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * BULK VISCOSITY
    * DYNAMIC
    * FIXED MASS SCALING
    * BULK VISCOSITY
    * DYNAMIC
    * VARIABLE MASS SCALING

    Note

    Check [ExplicitDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   This method modifies the ExplicitDynamicsStep object.

        Note

        Check [ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period for the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is ON.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying that an adiabatic stress analysis is to be performed. The default
                value is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC_GLOBAL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, FIXED\_USER\_DEFINED\_INC, and FIXED\_EBE. The default
                value is AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL.

            maxIncrement=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.maxIncrement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum time increment. If there is no upper limit,
                **maxIncrement** = None. This argument is required only when
                **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL or AUTOMATIC\_EBE. The default value is None.

            scaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.scaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor that is used to scale the time increment. This argument is
                required only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, or
                FIXED\_EBE. The default value is 1.0.

            massScaling=`abaqusConstants.PREVIOUS_STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.massScaling "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A MassScalingArray object specifying mass scaling controls. The default value is
                PREVIOUS\_STEP.

            linearBulkViscosity=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.linearBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the linear bulk viscosity parameter, b1b1. The default value is 0.06.

            quadBulkViscosity=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.quadBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the quadratic bulk viscosity parameter, b2b2. The default value is
                1.2.

            userDefinedInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.userDefinedInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the user-defined time increment. This argument is required
                only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = FIXED\_USER\_DEFINED\_INC. The default value is None.

            improvedDtMethod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ExplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.improvedDtMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to use the “improved” (*improvedDtMethod* = ON) or
                “conservative” (*improvedDtMethod* = OFF) method to estimate the element stable time
                increment for three-dimensional continuum elements and elements with plane stress
                formulations (shell, membrane, and two-dimensional plane stress elements). The default
                value is ON.

                New in version 2018: The **improvedDtMethod** argument was added.

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The FrequencyStep object is used to perform eigenvalue extraction to calculate the natural frequencies
    and corresponding mode shapes of a system. The FrequencyStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * FREQUENCY
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [FrequencyStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of acoustic-structural coupling in models with
        acoustic and structural elements coupled using the TIE option or in models with ASI-type
        elements. Possible values are AC\_ON, AC\_OFF, and AC\_PROJECTION. The default value is
        AC\_ON.

    normalization : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'DISPLACEMENT'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L96-L102)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.normalization "Permalink to this definition")

        indicates normalizing the eigenvectors so that the largest displacement entry in each

        the structure’s mass matrix, which results in scaling the eigenvectors so that the
        generalized mass for each vector is unity.

    projectDamping : --is-rst--Boolean = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L112-L115)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.projectDamping "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to include projection of viscous and structural damping
        operators during **AMS** eigenvalue extraction. Valid only when **eigenSolver** = AMS. The
        default value is ON.

    propertyEvaluationFrequency : --is-rst--float | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L104-L110)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.propertyEvaluationFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a Float specifying the frequency at which to evaluate frequency-dependent
        properties for viscoelasticity, springs, and dashpots during the eigenvalue extraction.
        If the value is None, the analysis product will evaluate the stiffness associated with
        frequency-dependent springs and dashpots at zero frequency and will not consider the
        stiffness contributions from frequency-domain viscoelasticity in the step. The default
        value is None.

    residualModeDof : --is-rst--int | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L166-L168)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModeDof "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a tuple of Ints specifying the degree of freedom for which residual modes are
        requested. The default value is None.

    residualModeRegion : --is-rst--tuple | None = `None`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L162-L164)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModeRegion "Permalink to this definition")
    :   None or a tuple of Strings specifying the name of a region for which residual modes are
        requested. The default value is None.

    residualModes : --is-rst--Boolean = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L139-L141)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.residualModes "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether to include residual modes from an immediately preceding

    :   A Float specifying the second cutoff frequency for a reduced eigenproblem defined as a

    :   This method modifies the FrequencyStep object.

        Note

        Check [FrequencyStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   numEigen=`abaqusConstants.ALL`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.numEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant ALL or an Int specifying the number of eigenvalues to be calculated
                or ALL. The default value is ALL.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            shift=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.shift "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the shift point in cycles per time. The default value is 0.0.

            minEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.minEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the minimum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            maxEigen=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.maxEigen "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum frequency of interest in cycles per time. The
                default value is None.

            vectors=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.vectors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or an Int specifying the number of vectors used in the iteration. The default is
                the minimum of (2\*n\*, **n** + 8), where **n** is the number of eigenvalues requested. The
                default value is None.

            maxIterations=`30`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.maxIterations "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of iterations. The default value is 30.

            blockSize=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.blockSize "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the size of the Lanczos block steps. The default value is
                DEFAULT.

            maxBlocks=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.maxBlocks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the maximum number of Lanczos block steps within each
                Lanczos run. The default value is DEFAULT.

            normalization=`abaqusConstants.DISPLACEMENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.normalization "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the method for normalizing eigenvectors. Possible values
                are DISPLACEMENT and MASS. The default value is DISPLACEMENT.A value of DISPLACEMENT
                indicates normalizing the eigenvectors so that the largest displacement entry in each
                vector is unity. A value of MASS indicates normalizing the eigenvectors with respect to
                the structure’s mass matrix, which results in scaling the eigenvectors so that the
                generalized mass for each vector is unity.

            propertyEvaluationFrequency=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.propertyEvaluationFrequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the frequency at which to evaluate frequency-dependent
                properties for viscoelasticity, springs, and dashpots during the eigenvalue extraction.
                If the value is None, the analysis product will evaluate the stiffness associated with
                frequency-dependent springs and dashpots at zero frequency and will not consider the
                stiffness contributions from frequency-domain viscoelasticity in the step. The default
                value is None.

            projectDamping=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.projectDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include projection of viscous and structural damping
                operators during **AMS** eigenvalue extraction. Valid only when **eigenSolver** = AMS. The
                default value is ON.

            acousticCoupling=`abaqusConstants.AC_ON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.acousticCoupling "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of acoustic-structural coupling in models with
                acoustic and structural elements coupled using the TIE option or in models with ASI-type
                elements. Possible values are AC\_ON, AC\_OFF, and AC\_PROJECTION. The default value is
                AC\_ON.

            acousticRangeFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.acousticRangeFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the ratio of the maximum acoustic frequency to the maximum structural
                frequency. The default value is 1.0.

            frictionDamping=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.frictionDamping "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to add to the damping matrix contributions due to friction
                effects. The default value is OFF.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            simLinearDynamics=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.simLinearDynamics "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to activate the SIM-based linear dynamics procedures. The
                default value is OFF.

            residualModes=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.residualModes "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to include residual modes from an immediately preceding
                Static, Linear Perturbation step. The default value is OFF.

            substructureCutoffMultiplier=`5`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.substructureCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the cutoff frequency for substructure eigenproblems, defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 5.0.

            firstCutoffMultiplier=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.firstCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the first cutoff frequency for a reduced eigenproblem, defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 1.7.

            secondCutoffMultiplier=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.secondCutoffMultiplier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the second cutoff frequency for a reduced eigenproblem defined as a
                multiplier of the maximum frequency of interest. The default value is 1.1.

            residualModeRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.residualModeRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Strings specifying the name of a region for which residual modes
                are requested. The default value is None.

            residualModeDof=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.residualModeDof "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a sequence of Ints specifying the degree of freedom for which residual modes are
                requested. The default value is None.

            limitSavedEigenvectorRegion=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.FrequencyStep.setValues.limitSavedEigenvectorRegion "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Region object specifying a region for which eigenvectors should be saved or
                the SymbolicConstant None representing the whole model. The default value is None.

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The GeostaticStep object is used to verify that the geostatic stress field is in equilibrium with the
    applied loads and boundary conditions on the model and to iterate, if needed, to obtain equilibrium. The
    GeostaticStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * GEOSTATIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [GeostaticStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The HeatTransferStep object is used to control uncoupled heat transfer for either transient or steady-
    state response. The HeatTransferStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * HEAT TRANSFER
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [HeatTransferStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ImplicitDynamicsStep object is used to provide direct integration of a dynamic stress/displacement
    response in Abaqus/Standard analyses and is generally used for nonlinear cases. The ImplicitDynamicsStep
    object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DYNAMIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [ImplicitDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).
