    :   This method modifies the ImplicitDynamicsStep object.

        Note

        Check [ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period of the step. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is based on the previous step.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            application=`abaqusConstants.ANALYSIS_PRODUCT_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.application "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the application type of the step. Possible values are
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT, TRANSIENT\_FIDELITY, MODERATE\_DISSIPATION, and QUASI\_STATIC.
                The default value is ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether an adiabatic stress analysis is to be performed. The
                default value is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed.

            hafTolMethod=`abaqusConstants.VALUE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.hafTolMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the way of specifying half-increment residual tolerance
                with the automatic time incrementation scheme. Possible values are
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT, VALUE, and SCALE. The default value is VALUE.

            haftol=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.haftol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the half-increment residual tolerance to be used with the
                automatic time incrementation scheme. The default value is None.

            halfIncScaleFactor=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.halfIncScaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the half-increment residual tolerance scale factor to be used
                with the automatic time incrementation scheme. The default value is None.

            nohaf=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.nohaf "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to suppress calculation of the half-increment residual. The
                default value is OFF.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is STEP.

            alpha=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant DEFAULT or a Float specifying the nondefault value of the numerical
                (artificial) damping control parameter, αα, in the implicit operator. Possible values
                are −.333 <α< 0. The default value is DEFAULT.

            initialConditions=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.initialConditions "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether accelerations should be calculated or recalculated
                at the beginning of the step. Possible values are DEFAULT, BYPASS, and ALLOW. The
                default value is DEFAULT.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.ANALYSIS_PRODUCT_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR,
                PARABOLIC, VELOCITY\_PARABOLIC, and ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT. The default value is
                ANALYSIS\_PRODUCT\_DEFAULT.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed have been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = OFF only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ImplicitDynamicsStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

*class* InitialStep[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/InitialStep.py#L22-L121)[¶](#abaqus.Step.InitialStep.InitialStep "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The InitialStep object is a placeholder that you cannot create, delete, or modify. The InitialStep object
    exists in every model by default and is used to allow the preexisting boundary conditions and interactions
    to be defined in the model. The InitialStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [InitialStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The MassDiffusionStep object is used to control uncoupled transient or steady-state mass diffusion
    analysis. The MassDiffusionStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * MASS DIFFUSION
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [MassDiffusionStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

parameter)")=`None`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L30-L286)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.ModalDynamicsStep "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ModalDynamicsStep object is used to provide dynamic time history response as a linear perturbation
    procedure using modal superposition. The ModalDynamicsStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DAMPING
    * MODAL DAMPING
    * MODAL DYNAMIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [ModalDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The RandomResponseStep object is used to give the linearized response of a model to random excitation.
    The RandomResponseStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DAMPING
    * MODAL DAMPING
    * RANDOM RESPONSE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [RandomResponseStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ResponseSpectrumStep object is used to calculate estimates of peak values of displacements and
    stresses based on user-supplied response spectra and on the natural modes of the system. The
    ResponseSpectrumStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * RESPONSE SPECTRUM
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [ResponseSpectrumStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The SoilsStep object is used to specify transient (consolidation) or steady-state response analysis of
    partially or fully saturated fluid-filled porous media. The SoilsStep object is derived from the
    AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SOILS
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SoilsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
        strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
        value is 0.05.

        results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
        the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            response=`abaqusConstants.TRANSIENT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.response "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the analysis type. Possible values are STEADY\_STATE and
                TRANSIENT. The default value is TRANSIENT.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the
                step. The default value is OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            creep=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.creep "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether a creep response occurs during this step. The default value
                is ON.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            end=`abaqusConstants.PERIOD`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.end "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time period to be analyzed in a transient analysis.
                Possible values are PERIOD and SS. The default value is PERIOD.

            utol=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.utol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum pore pressure change permitted in any increment
                (in pressure units) in a transient consolidation analysis. The default value is None.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable difference in the creep strain increment
                calculated from the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The
                default value is 0.0.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. The default value is STEP. Possible values are STEP and RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SoilsStep.setValues.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The StaticLinearPerturbationStep object is used to indicate that the static step should be analyzed as a
    linear perturbation load step. The StaticLinearPerturbationStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep
    object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * STATIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [StaticLinearPerturbationStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

            gapDistance=`0.0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticLinearPerturbationStep.setValues.gapDistance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the zone within which potential contact constraints are exposed to the LCP solver,
                applicable when solutionTechnique is LCP\_CONTACT.

                New in version 2024: The argument `gapDistance` was added.

            :   A Float specifying the scaling factor for the initial gap distance specified by gapDistance or the
                internally computed (contact) pair-wise gap distances, applicable when solutionTechnique is LCP\_CONTACT.

                New in version 2024: The argument `scaleFactor` was added.

definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The StaticRiksStep object is used to indicate that the step should be analyzed as a static load step
    using the modified Riks method for proportional loading cases. The StaticRiksStep object is derived from the
    AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * STATIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [StaticRiksStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to perform an adiabatic stress analysis. The default value
                is OFF.

            maxLPF=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.maxLPF "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum value of the load proportionality factor. The
                default value is None.

            nodeOn=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.nodeOn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to monitor the finishing displacement value at a node. The
                default value is OFF.

            maximumDisplacement=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.maximumDisplacement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the total displacement (or rotation) at the node and
                degree of freedom that, if crossed during an increment, ends the step at the current
                increment. This argument is required when **nodeOn** = ON. The default value is 0.0.

            dof=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.dof "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the degree of freedom being monitored. This argument is required when
                **nodeOn** = ON. The default value is 0.

            region=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.region "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Region object specifying the vertex at which the finishing displacement value is being
                monitored. This argument is required when **nodeOn** = ON.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            totalArcLength=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.totalArcLength "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total load proportionality factor associated with the load in
                this step. The default value is 1.0.

            initialArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.initialArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial load proportionality factor. The default value is the
                total load proportionality factor for the step.

            minArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.minArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum arc length increment allowed. The default value is the
                smaller of the suggested initial load proportionality factor or 10−5 times the total
                load proportionality factor for the step.

            maxArcInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.maxArcInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum arc length increment allowed. The default value is the
                total load proportionality factor for the step.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            fullyPlastic=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.fullyPlastic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the region being monitored for fully Plastic behavior.
                The default value is an empty string.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed have been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = ON only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            useLongTermSolution=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.useLongTermSolution "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying wether to obtain the fully relaxed long-term elastic solution with
                time-domain viscoelasticity or the long-term elastic-Plastic solution for two-layer
                viscoplasticity. The default value is OFF.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticRiksStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The StaticStep object is used to indicate that the step should be analyzed as a static load step. The
    StaticStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * STATIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [StaticStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   This method modifies the StaticStep object.

        Note

        Check [StaticStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            adiabatic=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.adiabatic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to perform an adiabatic stress analysis. The default value
                is OFF.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10⁻⁵ times the total time period.

            maxInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default value is the total
                time period for the step.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.RAMP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is RAMP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            fullyPlastic=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.fullyPlastic "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the region being monitored for fully Plastic behavior. The default
                value is an empty string.

            noStop=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.noStop "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to accept the solution to an increment after the maximum
                number of iterations allowed has been completed, even if the equilibrium tolerances are
                not satisfied. The default value is OFF.Warning:You should set **noStop** = ON only in
                special cases when you have a thorough understanding of how to interpret the results.

            useLongTermSolution=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.useLongTermSolution "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying wether to obtain the fully relaxed long-term elastic solution with
                time-domain viscoelasticity or the long-term elastic-Plastic solution for two-layer
                viscoplasticity. The default value is OFF.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        Raises:[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.StaticStep.setValues-raises "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **RangeError** –

*class* SteadyStateDirectStep(*[name](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.name (Python parameter)")*, *[previous](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.previous (Python parameter)")*, *[frequencyRange](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.frequencyRange (Python parameter)")*, *[description](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.description (Python parameter)")=`''`*, *[factorization](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.factorization (Python parameter)")=`abaqusConstants.COMPLEX`*, *[scale](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.scale (Python parameter)")=`abaqusConstants.LOGARITHMIC`*, *[matrixStorage](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.matrixStorage (Python parameter)")=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`*, *[maintainAttributes](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.maintainAttributes (Python parameter)")=`False`*, *[subdivideUsingEigenfrequencies](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.subdivideUsingEigenfrequencies (Python parameter)")=`0`*, *[frictionDamping](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep.__init__.frictionDamping (Python parameter)")=`0`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepModel.py#L35-L272)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepModel.SteadyStateDirectStep "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The SteadyStateDirectStep object is used to calculate the linearized steady-state response of the system
    to harmonic excitation in terms of the physical degrees of freedom of the model. The SteadyStateDirectStep
    object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * STEADY STATE DYNAMICS
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SteadyStateDirectStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

            :   A Boolean specifying whether to subdivide each frequency range using the

            :   A Boolean specifying whether to add to the damping matrix contributions due to friction

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    He SteadyStateModalStep object is used to calculate the linearized steady-state response of the system to
    harmonic excitation. The SteadyStateModalStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DAMPING
    * MODAL DAMPING
    * STEADY STATE DYNAMICS
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SteadyStateModalStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The SteadyStateSubspaceStep object is used to calculate the linearized steady-state response of the
    system to harmonic excitation on the basis of the subspace projection method. The SteadyStateSubspaceStep
    object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * STEADY STATE DYNAMICS
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SteadyStateSubspaceStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* StepBase[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/StepBase.py#L22-L134)[¶](#abaqus.Step.StepBase.StepBase "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The Step object stores the parameters that determine the context of the step. The Step object is the
    abstract base type for other Step objects. The Step object has no explicit constructor. The methods and
    members of the Step object are common to all objects derived from the Step.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    Note

    Check [StepBase on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The SubspaceDynamicsStep object is used to calculate the linearized steady-state response of the system
    to harmonic excitation on the basis of the subspace projection method. The SubspaceDynamicsStep object is
    derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * DYNAMIC
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SubspaceDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

            :   A Float specifying the total time period of the step. The default value is 1.0.

            :   The SymbolicConstant ALL or an Int specifying the number of modes to be used for

                value is ALL.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.SubspaceDynamicsStep.SubspaceDynamicsStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is

            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            incSize=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.SubspaceDynamicsStep.SubspaceDynamicsStep.setValues.incSize "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the suggested time increment. The default value is 0.0.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.SubspaceDynamicsStep.SubspaceDynamicsStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    TheSubstructureGenerateStep object is used to generate a substructure. The SubstructureGenerateStep
    object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SUBSTRUCTURE GENERATE
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [SubstructureGenerateStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The TempDisplacementDynamicsStep object is used to perform a dynamic coupled thermal-stress analysis
    using explicit integration. The TempDisplacementDynamicsStep object is derived from the AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * BULK VISCOSITY
    * DYNAMIC
    * FIXED MASS SCALING
    * BULK VISCOSITY
    * DYNAMIC
    * VARIABLE MASS SCALING

    Note

    Check [TempDisplacementDynamicsStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

            :   A Float specifying the time period of the step. The default value is 1.0.

            :   A Boolean specifying whether geometric nonlinearities should be accounted for during the

            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, FIXED\_USER\_DEFINED\_INC, and FIXED\_EBE. The default
                value is AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL.

            maxIncrement=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.setValues.maxIncrement "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. If there is no upper
                limit, **maxIncrement** = None. The default value is None.

            scaleFactor=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.setValues.scaleFactor "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor that is used to scale the time increment. This argument is
                required only when **timeIncrementationMethod** = AUTOMATIC\_GLOBAL, AUTOMATIC\_EBE, or
                FIXED\_EBE. The default value is 1.0.

            userDefinedInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.setValues.userDefinedInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   None or a Float specifying the user-defined time increment. The default value is None.

            quadBulkViscosity=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.TempDisplacementDynamicsStep.setValues.quadBulkViscosity "Permalink to this definition")

                “conservative” (*improvedDtMethod* = OFF) method to estimate the element stable time
                increment for three-dimensional continuum elements and elements with plane stress

:   Bases: [`AnalysisStep`](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.AnalysisStep "abaqus.Step.AnalysisStep.AnalysisStep (Python class)")

    The ViscoStep object is used to obtain a transient static response in an analysis with time-dependent
    material behavior (creep, swelling, and viscoelasticity). The ViscoStep object is derived from the
    AnalysisStep object.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import step
    mdb.models[name].steps[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * VISCO
    * STEP

    Note

    Check [ViscoStep on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total

    :   This method modifies the ViscoStep object.

        Note

        Check [ViscoStep.setValues on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-steppyc.htm?contextscope=all#simaker-stepsetvaluespyc).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying a description of the new step. The default value is an empty string.

            timePeriod=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.

            nlgeom=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.nlgeom "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether to allow for geometric nonlinearity. The default value is
                OFF.

            stabilizationMethod=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
                DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

            stabilizationMagnitude=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.stabilizationMagnitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
                problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 2x10⁻⁴.

            timeIncrementationMethod=`abaqusConstants.AUTOMATIC`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
                are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

            matrixSolver=`abaqusConstants.DIRECT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.matrixSolver "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of solver. Possible values are DIRECT and
                ITERATIVE. The default value is DIRECT.

            matrixStorage=`abaqusConstants.SOLVER_DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.matrixStorage "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of matrix storage. Possible values are SYMMETRIC,
                UNSYMMETRIC, and SOLVER\_DEFAULT. The default value is SOLVER\_DEFAULT.

            initialInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.initialInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the initial time increment. The default value is the total time
                period for the step.

            maxNumInc=`100`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.maxNumInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of increments in a step. The default value is 100.

            minInc=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.minInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the minimum time increment allowed. The default value is the smaller
                of the suggested initial time increment or 10−5 times the total time period.

            maxInc=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.maxInc "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum time increment allowed. The default is the total time
                period for the step. The default value is 1.0.

            integration=`abaqusConstants.IMPLICIT_EXPLICIT`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.integration "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying which type of integration to use throughout the step.
                Possible values are IMPLICIT\_EXPLICIT and EXPLICIT\_ONLY. The default value is
                IMPLICIT\_EXPLICIT.

            cetol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.cetol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum difference in the creep strain increment calculated from
                the creep strain rates at the beginning and end of the increment. The default value is
                0.0.

            amplitude=`abaqusConstants.STEP`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.amplitude "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the amplitude variation for loading magnitudes during the
                step. Possible values are STEP and RAMP. The default value is STEP.

            extrapolation=`abaqusConstants.LINEAR`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.extrapolation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of extrapolation to use in determining the
                incremental solution for a nonlinear analysis. Possible values are NONE, LINEAR, and
                PARABOLIC. The default value is LINEAR.

            solutionTechnique=`abaqusConstants.FULL_NEWTON`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
                Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

            reformKernel=`8`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.reformKernel "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of quasi-Newton iterations allowed before the kernel matrix
                is reformed.. The default value is 8.

            convertSDI=`abaqusConstants.PROPAGATED`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.convertSDI "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying whether to force a new iteration if severe discontinuities
                occur during an iteration. Possible values are PROPAGATED, CONVERT\_SDI\_OFF, and
                CONVERT\_SDI\_ON. The default value is PROPAGATED.

            adaptiveDampingRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.adaptiveDampingRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the maximum allowable ratio of the stabilization energy to the total
                strain energy and can be used only if **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
                value is 0.05.

            continueDampingFactors=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues.continueDampingFactors "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether this step will carry over the damping factors from the
                results of the preceding general step. This parameter must be used in conjunction with
                the **adaptiveDampingRatio** parameter. The default value is OFF.

        Raises:[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.setValues-raises "Permalink to this headline")
        :   **RangeError** –

    solutionTechnique : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'FULL_NEWTON'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/ViscoStep.py#L121-L123)[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.solutionTechnique "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the technique used to for solving nonlinear equations.
        Possible values are FULL\_NEWTON and QUASI\_NEWTON. The default value is FULL\_NEWTON.

    :   A SolverControl object.

    :   A Float specifying the damping intensity of the automatic damping algorithm if the
        problem is expected to be unstable, and **stabilizationMethod** is not NONE. The default
        value is 2x10⁻⁴.

    stabilizationMethod : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'NONE'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/ViscoStep.py#L66-L68)[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.stabilizationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the stabilization type. Possible values are NONE,
        DISSIPATED\_ENERGY\_FRACTION, and DAMPING\_FACTOR. The default value is NONE.

    suppressed : --is-rst--Boolean = `0`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/ViscoStep.py#L191-L192)[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.suppressed "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Boolean specifying whether the step is suppressed or not. The default value is OFF.

    timeIncrementationMethod : --is-rst--SymbolicConstant = `'AUTOMATIC'`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/ViscoStep.py#L75-L77)[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.timeIncrementationMethod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time incrementation method to be used. Possible values
        are FIXED and AUTOMATIC. The default value is AUTOMATIC.

    timePeriod : --is-rst--float = `1`[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Step/ViscoStep.py#L59-L60)[¶](#abaqus.Step.ViscoStep.ViscoStep.timePeriod "Permalink to this definition")
    :   A Float specifying the total time period. The default value is 1.0.
